prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: game world concept plus two alternative wizard sprites on one concept board.
Primary request: Warm calm flat 2D HTML Canvas wizard game, exact orthographic 90-degree overhead view. Create a landscape concept board with left 60% showing a portrait playable forest arena, right 40% showing TWO large additional wizard hat variants, stacked vertically. English labels only: "FOREST / TOP-DOWN", "02 / MOSS HAT", "03 / PARCHMENT HAT".
ALL THREE WIZARDS face screen UP. Critical orientation: wand a short vertical stick at exactly 12 o'clock, centered horizontally with hat, extending forward/up beyond brim. The hat's curved tip bends strictly BACKWARD toward exactly 6 o'clock, centered horizontally, pointing down. Forward wand and backward tip share the SAME vertical axis. NO diagonal wand, NO sideways hooked tip. Hat seen directly from above, dominant almost circular brim; central crown viewed overhead is a small rounded footprint tapering into a short bent tip toward lower edge WITHIN brim. No upright hat triangle. No face body eyes hands feet. Only hat and wand. No character side surfaces, no tilt, no isometric.
Left GAMEPLAY: Spacious pale moss green circular arena joined to straight corridor at top, dark muted green exterior, minimal dark irregular outline. Almost no obstacles ON arena; two overhead tree canopy blobs OUTSIDE playable edge, a few tiny grass strokes outside. Player at lower-middle arena: coral hat #EF795E, dark pine #182C28 outlines, ochre band and rectangular buckle on crown base, a sage patch and subtle stitches; central curved tip points screen DOWN/backward, wand centered above hat points straight UP/forward. Wand wood brass crystal, small clear silhouette. Two tiny enemies at upper arena, heads viewed directly overhead: dark green round head shapes with side ears and just crown markings, no faces staring at viewer and no standing bodies. One small diamond rune pickup. Minimal parchment HUD top health bar, lower left faint joystick, lower right wand/rune slots; no invented minimap. Empty navigable space dominates.
Right variant 02: larger overhead wizard moss/sage hat with ochre band, one coral patch and 3 short cloth crease marks. Backward central tip down, forward central wand up. Variant 03: parchment/light cream hat with coral band and one embroidered small moss star, brass buckle. Backward tip down, forward wand up. Each isolated on plain parchment. Include small vertical direction marker with "FORWARD" above each wand and "BACK" below each hat, clarify exact axis. These are alternate skins of identical geometry, same warm storybook shape language. Bottom small swatches #182C28 #496B4A #B8C88D #E9DDBB #C58A45 #EF795E.
Rendering: clean flat solid fills, chunky hand-drawn contours, restrained 2 flat tone fold accents, sprite designs readable at 48px, no gradients, no dramatic shading, no detailed textures, no floor brick pattern, no dense scenery, no vertical surfaces or shelf fronts, no realistic lighting, no cast shadow, no glow. The world itself must be true flat 2D overhead plan view, not fantasy illustration with perspective. IMPORTANT: in every wizard wand points UP and central curved hat tip points DOWN, never diagonal or lateral.
